dependencies.basis: Japanese System of National Accounts (JSNA) was transitioned to the 2008 SNA international standard with the 2011 (Heisei 23) benchmark revision and subsequent updates.
dependencies.evidence_quote: 従前、JSNA が準拠してきた国際基準は、1993 年に国連で採択された「1993SNA」であり、平成12 年以降採用してきましたが、平成28 年末に実施した「平成23 年基準改定」に際して...最新の国際基準であり、平成21 年2 月に国連で採択された「2008SNA」に対応しています。

dependencies.basis: CPI item weights are calculated primarily from average household consumption expenditures obtained from the Family Income and Expenditure Survey (FIES).
dependencies.evidence_quote: The weight is mainly calculated from the average monthly expenditure by item per household in 2019 and 2020, which is obtained from the Family Income and Expenditure Survey (FIES) (Fundamental Statistical Survey based on the Statistics Act)

dependencies.basis: Japan's Balance of Payments related statistics are compiled in accordance with the sixth edition of the IMF Balance of Payments and International Investment Position Manual (BPM6).
dependencies.evidence_quote: Japan's BOP related statistics are compiled in accordance with the sixth edition of the Balance of Payments and International Investment Position Manual (BPM6) published by the International Monetary Fund (IMF) in 2008.

dependencies.basis: The Korean System of National Accounts compiled by the Bank of Korea follows the 2008 System of National Accounts (SNA) as its analytical framework and compilation standard.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Analytical framework: The compilation standard follows the 2008 System of National Accounts (SNA). The Bank of Korea (BOK) completed the transition from the fixed weighted method to the chained weighted method in March, 2009.

dependencies.basis: Statistics Korea has adopted the COICOP classification for the CPI (12 major groups aligned with COICOP).
dependencies.evidence_quote: Recently, the KOSTAT has adopted the COICOP classification. The CPI has 12 major groups: Food and non-alcoholic beverages ... The classification and sectorization used in the compilation of the CPI are in broad conformity with the 1993 SNA, COICOP, and the ILO’s CPI Manual guidelines.

dependencies.basis: CPI weights are derived from the Household Income and Expenditure Survey (or related household expenditure survey results).
dependencies.evidence_quote: Sources of weights: The weights are derived from the 2020 Household Income and Expenditure Survey (HIES), which is conducted by Statistics Korea.

dependencies.basis: Korea's Balance of Payments statistics are compiled consistently with the IMF's Balance of Payments and International Investment Position Manual, 6th edition (BPM6).
dependencies.evidence_quote: The concepts and definitions of the Korea's BOP statistics are broadly consistent with the IMF's Balance of Payments and International Investment Position Manual, 6th edition (BPM6).

dependencies.basis: Japan's Input-Output Tables are positioned within the System of National Accounts framework and are compiled with reference to SNA recommendations on concepts, definitions and classifications.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The 2008 United Nation recommendations for SNA which needs to comply with the concepts, definitions, etc. of the Input-Output tables classifications

dependencies.basis: Gross Regional Domestic Product (GRDP) estimation follows the conceptual framework of the System of National Accounts, including 2008 SNA recommendations on treatment of R&D and military equipment as fixed capital.
dependencies.evidence_quote: 단, 상품개발을 위한 연구개발비와 정부가 구입하는 군사장비는 2008SNA 권고에 따라 고정자본
